notes: v1.14.583 — STATUS-HONESTY. SITE-SYNC ship 1, owner GO 2026-09-08 — the first ship after PREVIEW-DIAG (.582) was device-verified and stamped. ONE VISIBLE CHANGE: Build's execution strip reads 'LOCAL ACTIVE | ON-DEVICE · SAVED' where it read 'LOCAL ACTIVE | SYNCED'. WHY: 'SYNCED' was written whenever navigator.onLine was not false and meant nothing else — there is no server holding site state, no sync queue (bw_hasPendingWrites is a placeholder returning false), and no other phone to be in sync with. A label after a mechanism the app does not have is a Contract B10 violation, and a technician reading SYNCED on a second phone would believe the first phone's work had reached it. It had not. The strip now states the only claim it can prove: the work is saved on this device. OFFLINE still reads 'ON-DEVICE · OFFLINE', unchanged. SITE-SYNC §7.1 owns the future vocabulary (SYNCING n / SYNCED · time / SYNC FAILED) and it returns only when sync exists. ONE executable line changed at :22143 plus its note; no CSS, no data path, no new door. ⚠ LEADS, NOT FIXED HERE: the strip's dot-colour rules (:59035–:59037) use :contains(), which no engine implements, so the dot is always green; and 'PENDING CHANGES' is unreachable because the placeholder never returns true. Both recorded for the dead-CSS ledger, neither touched. PINNED by test/e2e/50-status-honesty.spec.js: the strip never contains SYNCED, reads ON-DEVICE · SAVED online and ON-DEVICE · OFFLINE when navigator.onLine is false.
